claude_result_text: The windows and doors have been significantly improved. The main deck windows are now larger and better distributed along the fuselage, providing a more realistic aircraft appearance. The upper-deck windows were adjusted to $y=9.5$ to properly align with the hump's surface, which was moved up in a previous step to fix overlapping issues between the two decks. Finally, the cockpit windshields were redesigned with much larger dimensions and wider wrap-around angles (30 to 45 degrees) to ensure they are clearly visible from both front and side perspectives, addressing the "crude streaks" critique. All these changes together provide a more cohesive and polished representation of a Boeing 747 while maintaining the "primitives only" constraint.
